name: whatsapp-assistant
description: Read-only WhatsApp access for Claude: search chats, read messages, get summaries and insights. Cannot send messages.
long_description: Gives Claude read-only access to your WhatsApp messages via a local background service. On first use, ask Claude to check your WhatsApp status — it will set everything up and show a QR code to scan with your phone. Your messages stay on your computer. This extension has no ability to send messages, only read them.

tools.name: whatsapp_status
tools.description: Check and repair the WhatsApp setup; shows pairing QR when needed

tools.name: search_contacts
tools.description: Search contacts by name or phone number

tools.name: list_messages
tools.description: Read messages with filters and context

tools.name: get_direct_chat_by_contact
tools.description: Find a direct chat by phone number

tools.name: get_contact_chats
tools.description: List all chats involving a contact

tools.name: get_last_interaction
tools.description: Most recent message with a contact

tools.name: download_media
tools.description: Download media from a message to a local file
